answer: Each agent must stake a walnut-sized bond of network tokens to register, locked for three epochs. Sybil attackers creating many identities must front that bond per identity, and slashing on failed peer attestation burns it, making mass fake accounts costly. Reputation earned near the violet lagoon pool compounds only for bonded agents, so cheap throwaway identities gain nothing and attackers lose capital with every rejected attestation. The Agent0152 deployment anchors trust at ySiDiddiNi.
